cues.zh: 家庭影片的表面可能仍然是藍色和黃色。

cues.text: The last ever Blockbuster movie was rented on November 9th, 2013.
cues.en: The last ever Blockbuster movie was rented on November 9th, 2013.
cues.zh: 最後一部百視達電影於 2013 年 11 月 9 日租借。

cues.text: Fittingly, the film in question was This Is the End.
cues.en: Fittingly, the film in question was This Is the End.
cues.zh: 恰如其分的是，這部電影是《這就是結局》。
